learning_outcomes.text: Propose systems and carry out projects on mechanical installations, structures, and manufacturing systems.
Acquire knowledge in manufacturing systems and materials, enabling them to learn new methods and theories, and providing versatility to adapt to new situations.
Express and communicate ideas and systems related to manufacturing systems and materials.
Understand and prepare professional technical documentation, in the context of activities related to manufacturing systems and materials.
Master the basic concepts of materials and their relationship with engineering aspects.

syllabus_topics: Tensile testing. Elastic modulus and yield strength

assessment_methods.method: Group work applying, analyzing, developing, or covering part of the subject
Laboratory practices and individual work solving problems and analyzing results obtained in practices

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 5 out of 10 is required on the final written exam to average with the rest of the components. The written exam is recoverable. The group work and laboratory practices/individual work are not recoverable.
